normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She said that she had already anticipated the outcome.
options: A. 她說她無法接受這個結果。
B. 她說她還要再評估一次結果。
C. 她說她不想知道最後的結果。
D. 她說她早已預料到這個結果。
normal.explain: 原句：She said that she had already anticipated the outcome. 意思是「她說她早已預料到這個結果」（間接引語與過去完成式）。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If they had modified the plan, it would have worked.
options: A. 如果他們當初修改了計畫，就會成功了。
B. 如果他們不修改計畫，一定會失敗。
C. 他們正在修改計畫，希望能成功。
D. 他們不會修改已經成功的計畫。
normal.explain: 原句：If they had modified the plan, it would have worked. 意思是「如果他們當初修改了計畫，就會成功了」（與過去事實相反的假設）。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He told me that the machine had malfunctioned again.
options: A. 他告訴我機器剛剛修好了。
B. 他告訴我機器又發生故障了。
C. 他告訴我要買一台新機器。
D. 他告訴我機器的操作方式。
normal.explain: 原句：He told me that the machine had malfunctioned again. 意思是「他告訴我機器又發生故障了」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If I were the manager, I would delegate the task.
options: A. 因為我是經理，所以我已經指派了任務。
B. 我不想當經理，因為任務太多了。
C. 如果我是經理，我會委派這項任務。
D. 經理應該要自己完成所有的任務。
normal.explain: 原句：If I were the manager, I would delegate the task. 意思是「如果我是經理，我會委派這項任務」（與現在事實相反的假設）。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They announced that the controversy had been resolved.
options: A. 他們宣布明天將舉行辯論。
B. 他們宣布爭議即將開始。
C. 他們宣布無法解決這個問題。
D. 他們宣布爭議已經解決了。
normal.explain: 原句：They announced that the controversy had been resolved. 意思是「他們宣布爭議已經解決了」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If she hadn't hesitated, she would have got the promotion.
options: A. 如果她當初沒有猶豫，就會得到晉升了。
B. 只要她不猶豫，明天就能晉升。
C. 她因為太果斷而失去了晉升機會。
D. 她一直在猶豫是否要接受晉升。
normal.explain: 原句：If she hadn't hesitated, she would have got the promotion. 意思是「如果她當初沒有猶豫，就會得到晉升了」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: We were informed that the cognitive test had finished.
options: A. 我們被告知體能測驗即將開始。
B. 我們被告知認知測試已經結束。
C. 我們想知道如何參加認知測試。
D. 認知測試的結果讓我們很驚訝。
normal.explain: 原句：We were informed that the cognitive test had finished. 意思是「我們被告知認知測試已經結束」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If the weather were better, the scenery would be breathtaking.
options: A. 昨天的天氣很好，風景非常美。
B. 天氣太糟了，我們什麼都看不到。
C. 如果天氣好一點，風景會是美不勝收的。
D. 無論天氣如何，這裡的風景都很普通。
normal.explain: 原句：If the weather were better, the scenery would be breathtaking. 意思是「如果天氣好一點，風景會是美不勝收的」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He admitted that he had violated the safety rules.
options: A. 他堅稱自己遵守了所有的安全規定。
B. 他不知道這裡有任何的安全規定。
C. 他正在學習新的安全規定。
D. 他承認他違反了安全規定。
normal.explain: 原句：He admitted that he had violated the safety rules. 意思是「他承認他違反了安全規定」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If they provided an authentic experience, more tourists would come.
options: A. 如果他們提供道地的體驗，會有更多遊客來。
B. 遊客太多了，破壞了當地的體驗。
C. 他們拒絕提供任何特別的體驗給遊客。
D. 因為體驗不佳，遊客都不來了。
normal.explain: 原句：If they provided an authentic experience, more tourists would come. 意思是「如果他們提供道地的體驗，會有更多遊客來」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She mentioned that the implication was quite substantial.
options: A. 她說這件事完全沒有意義。
B. 她提到其涵義相當重大。
C. 她希望大家不要想太多。
D. 她抱怨這個解釋太複雜了。
normal.explain: 原句：She mentioned that the implication was quite substantial. 意思是「她提到其涵義相當重大」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If you had clarified earlier, we wouldn't have made the mistake.
options: A. 幸好你提早澄清，我們才沒犯錯。
B. 我們犯了錯，是因為你一直不肯說話。
C. 如果你早點澄清，我們就不會犯錯了。
D. 就算你澄清了，我們還是會犯錯。
normal.explain: 原句：If you had clarified earlier, we wouldn't have made the mistake. 意思是「如果你早點澄清，我們就不會犯錯了」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the client had accepted our compromise, what would have happened?
options: A. We will sign the contract tomorrow.
B. They are reviewing the terms right now.
C. We would have signed the deal immediately.
D. They didn't accept any of our suggestions.
normal.explain: 原句：If the client had accepted our compromise, what would have happened?（如果客戶接受了我們的妥協，會發生什麼事？）回應 C「我們本來會立刻簽約的」符合與過去事實相反的假設語氣。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Did he mention why the project was delayed?
options: A. Yes, he will finish it by next Friday.
B. He said that a technical glitch had ruined the system.
C. He doesn't want to talk to the manager.
D. No, he is still working on the new design.
normal.explain: 原句：Did he mention why the project was delayed?（他有提到專案為何延遲嗎？）回應 B「他說一個技術小故障破壞了系統」使用了間接引語與過去完成式，最為合理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If you found a defective product in your order, what would you do?
options: A. I would escalate the issue to the support team.
B. I had already bought a new one yesterday.
C. I will tell them it is perfectly fine.
D. I am going to buy more defective items.
normal.explain: 原句：If you found a defective product in your order, what would you do?（如果你在訂單中發現瑕疵品，你會怎麼做？）回應 A「我會將問題升級給客服團隊」符合第二類條件句（假設語氣）。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Why didn't you join the mountain expedition last week?
options: A. I will join it if I have time tomorrow.
B. Because it is a very famous mountain.
C. I enjoy climbing mountains with my friends.
D. If I had known about it, I would have joined.
normal.explain: 原句：Why didn't you join the mountain expedition last week?（你上週為什麼沒參加登山探險？）回應 D「如果我當時知道，我就會參加了」使用了第三類條件句來解釋過去的情況。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: What did the professor say about the new phenomenon?
options: A. She stated that she had never seen anything like it.
B. She says it is a very normal thing.
C. She will show us a video about it later.
D. She wants to know if we are hungry.
normal.explain: 原句：What did the professor say about the new phenomenon?（教授對這個新現象說了什麼？）回應 A「她聲明她以前從未見過類似的情況」使用了間接引語與過去完成式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the company offered better conditions, would the staff be more enthusiastic?
options: A. No, they had been very tired lately.
B. Yes, they definitely would be.
C. Yes, they are working very hard now.
D. No, the company will not close.
normal.explain: 原句：If the company offered better conditions, would the staff be more enthusiastic?（如果公司提供更好的條件，員工會更有熱忱嗎？）回應 B「是的，他們絕對會」符合第二類條件句的回答方式。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: Did the travel agent confirm the changes to our itinerary?
options: A. No, he will travel to Japan next month.
B. Yes, he is checking the weather report now.
C. Yes, he said that he had already emailed the new version.
D. No, he didn't like the food there.
normal.explain: 原句：Did the travel agent confirm the changes to our itinerary?（旅行社專員確認了我們行程的變更嗎？）回應 C「是的，他說他已經寄出新版本的電子郵件了」符合語境與文法要求。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If we hadn't taken the initiative, would the problem have been solved?
options: A. Yes, we are solving it right now.
B. No, it would have gotten much worse.
C. No, I don't want to take the initiative.
D. Yes, the problem will be solved tomorrow.
normal.explain: 原句：If we hadn't taken the initiative, would the problem have been solved?（如果我們當初沒有採取主動，問題會解決嗎？）回應 B「不，情況本來會變得更糟」使用了與過去事實相反的假設語氣。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: How did she react to the new regulations?
options: A. She is reading them carefully.
B. She will complain about them to the boss.
C. She said she felt quite pessimistic about them.
D. She didn't know what time it was.
normal.explain: 原句：How did she react to the new regulations?（她對新規定有什麼反應？）回應 C「她說她對此感到相當悲觀」使用了間接引語講述過去的反應。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If you were in charge of customer service, how would you handle this inconvenience?
options: A. I am writing an email to the customer.
B. I had already apologized to them.
C. I will not buy anything from this store.
D. I would offer a sincere apology first.
normal.explain: 原句：If you were in charge of customer service, how would you handle this inconvenience?（如果你負責客服，你會如何處理這個不便？）回應 D「我會先提供真誠的道歉」符合第二類條件句。

normal.desc: 【時態】By the time the director arrived, the team ___ the final presentation.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：過去完成式用來表示在過去某個時間點（主管到達時）之前已經完成的動作，故選 had finished。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If the company ___ more focus on sustainability, it would attract younger consumers.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：此為與現在事實相反的第二類條件句（If + 過去式, ... would + 原形動詞），故選 placed。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The client asked us when the new software update ___ available.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：引述過去的問題，時態需由未來式（will be）退後一步變成過去未來式（would be）。

normal.desc: 【時態】The algorithm ___ biased results before the developers noticed the issue.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在開發者注意到（過去式）之前，演算法持續產生的動作，需使用過去完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If they had implemented the new security protocols, the data breach ___.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：與過去事實相反的第三類條件句（If + 過去完成式, ... would have + 過去分詞）。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】She mentioned that she ___ the design draft the previous week.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：間接引語中提到上週（the previous week）發生的事，在過去的時間點之前完成，需用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【時態】I realized I ___ my laptop charger at the office.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：意識到（realized）發生在過去，而遺忘充電器發生在更早之前，需用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【字彙】A successful manager knows how to ___ tasks effectively to team members.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：delegate 意為「委派」，符合句意，指主管將任務委派給團隊成員。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If I ___ you, I would try to clarify the instructions with the supervisor.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：第二類條件句（If I were you...）表示與現在事實相反的假設，be 動詞固定用 were。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The technician explained that the system ___ a restart to function properly.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：主句動詞為過去式 explained，因此名詞子句內的時態應退後至過去式 needed。

normal.desc: 【字彙】The company decided to launch a new ___ to promote biodiversity in the region.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：initiative 當名詞指「新措施；倡議」，符合句意。initiation 意為入會儀式或開始。

normal.desc: 【時態】The presentation ___ smoothly until the projector suddenly broke down.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在投影機壞掉（過去事件）之前持續進行的狀態，用過去完成進行式最恰當。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If we had checked the schedule, we ___ the important keynote speech.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：第三類條件句，表示與過去事實相反的結果，使用 would not have + 過去分詞。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】He promised that he ___ the report by Friday afternoon.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：原本的句子是 I will submit...，轉為間接引述並配合過去式 promised，will 需改為 would。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Our goal is to ___ different departments to improve overall productivity.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：integrate 意為「整合」，指將不同部門結合以提升生產力，最符合語境。

normal.desc: 【時態】She was exhausted because she ___ non-stop for ten hours.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在過去某個時間點（was exhausted）之前持續進行的動作，使用過去完成進行式。

normal.desc: 【假設語氣】If the manual were clearer, users ___ so many technical questions.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：If 子句用過去式 were，表示與現在事實相反，主要子句應搭配 would + 原形動詞。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The reporter asked the activist how the new environmental policy ___ the community.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：主要動詞 asked 為過去式，名詞子句時態應搭配使用過去式 affected。

normal.desc: 【對話】John: 'Did you review the documents?' Mary: 'Yes, I ___ them before you even sent the reminder.'
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在發送提醒（過去式 sent）之前已經完成檢閱，需使用過去完成式 had reviewed。

normal.desc: 【對話】Manager: 'What did the client say?' Assistant: 'They said they ___ our proposal and would reply soon.'
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：間接引語中引述客戶「已經收到」提案，在 said 這個過去時間點之前發生的事需用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【句型】If the startup had secured the funding earlier, they ___ able to hire more engineers last quarter.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：第三類條件句描述與過去事實相反的情況，主要子句需用 would have + 過去分詞。

normal.desc: 【句型】The CEO emphasized that transparency ___ essential for building trust among team members.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：時態一致原則，主動詞 emphasized 為過去式，從屬子句中表示狀態的動詞也應退回過去式 was。（若視為不變真理也可用 is，但選項中無適當的 is）。

normal.desc: 【字彙】To address climate change, many nations are trying to reduce their greenhouse gas ___.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：greenhouse gas emissions 為固定搭配，意指溫室氣體「排放」。

normal.desc: 【句型】I wouldn't worry about the deadline if we ___ a larger team working on this project.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：主要子句為 wouldn't worry（與現在事實相反），If 子句應搭配過去式動詞 had。

normal.desc: 【對話】A: 'Why didn't you attend the workshop?' B: 'I ___ to, but an urgent issue came up.'
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：在緊急事件發生（came up）之前本來計畫參加，需用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Good leadership involves building a culture of ___ where everyone takes responsibility for their actions.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：accountability 意為「當責、負責」，指為自己的行為負責的文化，最符合句意。

normal.desc: 【間接引語】The customer complained that the device ___ breaking down every few days.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：主句動詞 complained 為過去式，名詞子句中的動詞應退後至過去式 kept。

normal.desc: 【句型】If they hadn't changed the original design, the product ___ much more appealing to users.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：與過去事實相反的假設語氣，主要子句使用 would have been。

normal.desc: 【字彙】During the interview, she explained how her previous experience would ___ the company's dynamic environment.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：enhance 意為「提升；增強」，符合面試時說明過往經驗能為公司帶來正面幫助的語境。

normal.desc: 【時態】The researchers realized that they ___ the data incorrectly from the start.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：意識到（realized）之前已經發生的動作（錯誤解讀數據），需用過去完成式。

normal.desc: 【短文】Notice: The office will undergo maintenance on Friday. Therefore, all employees must work remotely. The network upgrade, which had been delayed due to parts shortages, will finally take place. Q: Why was the network upgrade delayed previously?
options: A. Employees wanted to work remotely.
B. There was a lack of necessary components.
C. The office was closed on Friday.
D. The maintenance team was unavailable.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文中提到 due to parts shortages（因零件短缺而延遲），選項 B 的 a lack of necessary components 是同義替換。

normal.desc: 【短文】In a recent interview, tech leader Elon clarified his stance on automation. He stated that AI would eventually handle repetitive tasks, allowing humans to focus on creative problem-solving. However, he stressed the need for strict ethical guidelines. Q: What is Elon's view on the future of AI?
options: A. It will completely replace human workers.
B. It requires ethical rules while assisting with mundane tasks.
C. It should only be used for creative problem-solving.
D. It has no practical application in the modern workplace.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文指出 AI 將處理重複性工作並強調需要 strict ethical guidelines（嚴格的道德規範），故選 B。

normal.desc: 【短文】Environmental policy experts suggest that if governments had implemented stricter emission caps a decade ago, current global temperatures would not have risen so rapidly. Immediate action is now necessary to conserve remaining ecosystems. Q: What does the text imply about the past decade?
options: A. Governments acted quickly to stop global warming.
C. Emission caps were not strict enough.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：第三類條件句暗示「如果當時實施更嚴格的限制...」，代表過去十年並沒有這麼做，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【短文】Email to staff: 'I wanted to remind everyone about the upcoming leadership seminar. Ms. Davis, who had successfully led the transition project last year, will be our main speaker.' Q: What did Ms. Davis do previously?
options: A. She organized this week's seminar.
B. She failed to complete a project.
C. She guided a major transition initiative.
D. She reminded the staff about the meeting.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提及 she had successfully led the transition project（她成功領導了過渡專案），故選 C。

normal.desc: 【短文】Market Analysis: The smartphone market has reached saturation. If companies want to maintain growth, they must explore emerging markets or introduce revolutionary features. Otherwise, sales figures will stagnate. Q: According to the analysis, how can companies avoid stagnating sales?
options: A. By keeping their current features.
B. By exploring new, developing markets.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到若要維持成長，必須 explore emerging markets（探索新興市場），故選 B。

normal.desc: 【短文】During the town hall meeting, the mayor was asked if the city would increase the public transport budget. He replied that he had already submitted a request to the council the week before. Q: When did the mayor submit the budget request?
options: A. During the town hall meeting.
B. The week after the meeting.
C. Prior to the town hall meeting.
D. He hasn't submitted it yet.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：the week before 加上過去完成式 had already submitted，表示在市民大會之前就已經提交了。

normal.desc: 【短文】A new study on workplace dynamics shows that employees who receive regular feedback tend to stay longer. The researchers noted that if managers communicated more openly, turnover rates would drop significantly. Q: What is the main finding of the study?
options: A. Feedback has no impact on employee retention.
B. Open communication can reduce employee turnover.
C. Managers prefer not to give regular feedback.
D. Turnover rates are rising despite open communication.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提到若經理更開放地溝通，離職率（turnover rates）會顯著下降，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【短文】Memo: As discussed, we are integrating our old database with the new cloud system. If the IT team had started the process earlier, we wouldn't be experiencing these delays now. Please be patient. Q: Why is the company experiencing delays?
options: A. The cloud system is outdated.
B. The IT team started the integration process late.
C. Employees refused to be patient.
D. The old database was deleted.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中以假設語氣表示「如果 IT 團隊早點開始，現在就不會延遲」，暗示他們太晚開始，故選 B。

【經濟-時態】The government reported that the inflation rate ___ significantly before the new policy took effect.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。本句測試過去完成式 (had + p.p.)。主要子句的動作發生在過去式「took effect」之前，表達「在過去某個時間點之前已經完成的動作」，因此必須選過去完成式。B為現在式，C為現在完成式，D為未來式，皆不符合時態順序。

normal.desc: 【城市-假設】If the city built a better transit system, the daily commute ___ much easier.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B。本句為與現在事實相反的第二類條件句 (If + 過去式..., S + would/could/might + 原形動詞)。If 子句用了過去式 built，因此主要子句需搭配 would be。A為現在式，C為未來式，D為過去完成式，皆不符句型。

normal.desc: 【媒體-間接引語】The journalist asked if the editor ___ the sources for the controversial article.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。本句為間接引語。主要動詞 asked 為過去式，引述的內容若發生在更早之前，需退一步時態變成過去完成式 (had verified)。A、D為現在式，B為未來式，皆不符合時態一致性原則。

normal.desc: 【教育-字彙】The school board decided to update the ___ to include digital programming skills.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D (課程)。句意為「學校董事會決定更新課程以納入數位程式設計技能」。A為通勤，B為偏見，C為密度，皆不符合教育情境。

normal.desc: 【心理-時態】By the time the study concluded, the researchers ___ data from over a thousand participants.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。句首「By the time + 過去簡單式 (concluded)」表示「到過去某時為止」，主要子句需配合過去完成式 (had + p.p.) 來強調動作早已完成。B為現在進行式，C為現在簡單式，D為現在完成式，皆錯誤。

normal.desc: 【經濟-假設】If consumers had known about the hidden fees, they ___ the product.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B。本句為與過去事實相反的第三類條件句 (If + had p.p., S + would have p.p.)。If子句是 had known，主要子句應為 wouldn't have purchased。其他選項時態均不符合此假設語氣句型。

normal.desc: 【城市-間接引語】The mayor declared that the new residential area ___ additional public amenities soon.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。本句為間接引語。主要動詞 declared 是過去式，原本的未來式 (will receive) 需跟著往過去推一步，改為過去未來式 (would receive)。其餘選項皆未配合主要子句的時態退階。

normal.desc: 【媒體-字彙】It is highly recommended to check multiple news outlets to avoid being misled by ___ headlines.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D (聳動的)。句意為「強烈建議查閱多家新聞媒體，以免被聳動的標題誤導」。A為負擔得起的，B為認知的，C為住宅的，皆不符合語意。

normal.desc: 【教育-時態】The teacher realized that she ___ to upload the assignment to the online portal.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。主要動詞 realized (意識到) 是過去式，而「忘記上傳」是發生在「意識到」之前的動作，所以必須使用過去完成式。B為現在式，C為現在進行式，D為現在完成式，皆錯誤。

normal.desc: 【心理-假設】If human memory ___ perfectly reliable, we would not make so many errors in judgment.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B。本句為與現在事實相反的第二類條件句。在 If 子句中，無論主詞人稱，be 動詞一律使用 were。主要子句搭配了 would not make，證實此為假設語氣。A、C、D 皆非假設語氣的正確動詞形式。

normal.desc: 【經濟-字彙】The sudden drop in oil prices caused the cost of everyday goods to ___ wildly.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C (波動)。句意為「油價暴跌導致日常用品的成本劇烈波動」。A為補助，B為理解，D為核實，皆不符合語意。

normal.desc: 【城市-時態】Before they constructed the bridge, crossing the river ___ over an hour.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D。Before 子句用了過去式 constructed，表示「在建橋之前」，過河花費時間是更早之前持續的狀態或發生的動作，需使用過去完成式 (had taken)。其餘選項皆非過去時態。

normal.desc: 【媒體-假設】If the platform had enforced stricter rules, the fake news ___ so fast.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。此為第三類條件句 (與過去事實相反)。If 子句使用了 had enforced，主要子句需對應 would/could/might have + p.p.。B 為第二類條件句用法，C、D 為現在或未來的直陳用法。

normal.desc: 【心理-字彙】Developing emotional ___ helps individuals bounce back quickly from unexpected failures.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B (韌性/適應力)。句意為「培養情緒韌性有助於人們從意外失敗中迅速恢復」。A為通膨，C為支出，D為通勤，皆與心理學和情緒無關。

normal.desc: 【經濟-對話】A: 「Why are these affordable apartments sold out?」 B: 「They ___ all sold out before the advertisement was even printed.」
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。B的回答中提到了「before the advertisement was even printed (在廣告印出來之前)」，因為印廣告已經是過去式 (was printed)，所以「被賣光」這個更早發生的動作必須用過去完成式 (had been)。

normal.desc: 【城市-對話】A: 「The traffic density here is unbearable.」 B: 「I know. If more people took the subway, the roads ___ so congested.」
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D。這是一個與現在事實相反的假設語氣 (第二類條件句)。If 子句用了過去式 took，表示假設情況，主要子句則必須使用 would/could/might + 原形動詞，因此選 wouldn't be。

normal.desc: 【媒體-間接引語】「Did you read the deceptive article?」 John asked Mary if she ___ the deceptive article.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。直述句為過去式 (Did you read...)，當轉換為由過去式動詞 (asked) 引導的間接引語時，時態需往後推一步變成過去完成式 (had read)。

normal.desc: 【教育-字彙】A: 「How can we help students understand complex texts?」 B: 「We should focus on developing their ___ thinking skills early on.」
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B (批判性的)。critical thinking skills 意為「批判性思考能力」，是教育上幫助理解複雜文本的關鍵。A為住宅的，C為負擔得起的，D為聳動的，皆不符合語境。

normal.desc: 【心理-時態】The psychologist observed the children's behavior and found that those who ___ a nap performed better on the tests.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。主要動詞 found (發現) 與 performed (表現) 皆為過去式，而「睡午覺」是在表現更好之前的動作，因此需要用過去完成式 (had taken) 來表明動作的先後順序。

normal.desc: 【經濟-假設】「The market fluctuation is severe. If the central bank had intervened earlier, the currency ___ its value.」
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D。此句為與過去事實相反的第三類條件句。If 子句為 had intervened，主要子句必須是對應的 would have + p.p. 結構。其餘選項皆無法形成正確的假設語氣搭配。

normal.desc: 【城市-字彙】Due to the rapid population growth, providing ___ housing has become the biggest challenge for the government.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A (負擔得起的)。affordable housing 是常見搭配詞，意指「平價住宅 / 負擔得起的住房」。B為欺騙的，C為批判的/關鍵的，D為認知的，皆不符。

normal.desc: 【媒體-間接引語】A: 「I will verify the information before publishing.」 B: 「He said that he ___ the information before publishing.」
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B。將原句的 will verify 改寫為過去引述的間接引語 (He said that...) 時，助動詞 will 必須退一步變成過去式 would。

normal.desc: 【教育-時態】The professor was frustrated because half of the class ___ the assigned chapters before the lecture began.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。在教授感到沮喪 (was frustrated) 且課程開始 (began) 之前，學生「沒有讀完指定章節」這個動作早已經發生（或未發生），故須使用過去完成式 (hadn't read)。

normal.desc: 【心理-假設】「Our perception of reality is subjective. If everyone saw the world exactly the same way, there ___ no misunderstandings.」
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D。此句用 If 加上過去式動詞 saw 描述與現在事實相反的假設，主要子句必須搭配 would/could/might + 原形動詞，因此選 would be。

normal.desc: 【經濟-字彙】The start-up couldn't survive the economic downturn because their monthly ___ exceeded their income.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A (支出/花費)。句意為「這家新創公司無法撐過經濟衰退，因為他們的每月支出超過了收入」。B為同理心，C為韌性，D為課程，皆不合邏輯。

normal.desc: 【城市-時態】The residents complained that the construction noise ___ them awake for three consecutive nights before it stopped.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B。主要子句動詞 complained 與子句的 stopped 皆為過去式，而噪音讓人睡不著是發生在 stopped 之前的持續動作，必須用過去完成式 (had kept)。

normal.desc: 【短文】Market Update: Due to global supply chain disruptions, the prices of daily commodities have skyrocketed. Analysts noted that if local suppliers had stockpiled materials last quarter, the current inflation impact would have been milder. Q: What could have lessened the impact of inflation?
options: A. Ignoring the global supply chain.
B. Increasing the prices of daily commodities.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。短文中提到「如果當地供應商上季有囤積原料 (had stockpiled materials)，目前通膨的衝擊就會較輕微」，這與選項 C 提早囤積原料相符。

normal.desc: 【短文】Notice to Residents: The city council announced yesterday that they had secured funding for the new park. They stated that construction would begin next month, adding much-needed green amenities to our neighborhood. Q: When did the council secure the funding?
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D。文中提到市議會昨天宣布他們「已經取得 (had secured)」資金，過去完成式代表取得資金的動作發生在昨天宣布 (announced) 之前。

normal.desc: 【短文】In today's digital age, sensational headlines often spread faster than credible news. A recent study showed that users had shared fake stories 70% more often before fact-checkers could flag them. If platforms altered their algorithms, this trend would slow down. Q: What is a proposed solution to slow down the spread of fake stories?
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。短文最後一句指出「如果平台改變他們的演算法 (altered their algorithms)，這種趨勢就會減緩」，選項 A 的 changing 替換了 altered，意思一致。

normal.desc: 【短文】Educational Memo: We must update our curriculum to include media literacy. Many teachers reported that students had struggled to verify online information during the last research project. By facilitating these skills, we can prepare them for the real world. Q: What did students have difficulty doing in the past project?
options: C. Preparing for the real world.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B。短文中提到老師們報告「學生在上次研究專案中難以核實網路資訊 (had struggled to verify online information)」，完全對應選項 B。

normal.desc: 【短文】Behavioral Research: People often make decisions based on cognitive biases. The lead researcher explained that if participants had recognized their own bias, they would have made more rational choices during the simulation. Q: What prevented participants from making rational choices?
options: A. A lack of simulation tools.
C. A failure to recognize their own bias.
D. Poor instructions from the researcher.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。文中用第三類假設語氣表示「如果參與者有意識到自己的偏見，他們就會做出更理性的選擇」。反過來說，正是因為他們「未能意識到偏見 (failure to recognize their own bias)」，才無法做出理性選擇。

normal.desc: 【短文】Consumer Insight: A survey revealed that household expenditure on entertainment had dropped significantly before the holiday season. The report suggested that if inflation continued at this rate, families would cut their travel budgets entirely next year. Q: What did families do before the holiday season?
options: A. They increased their travel budgets.
B. They stopped worrying about inflation.
C. They bought more entertainment products.
D. They reduced their entertainment spending.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D。第一句明確寫到「在假期開始前，家庭在娛樂上的支出已經顯著下降 (had dropped significantly)」，選項 D 完美對應了這個意思。

normal.desc: 【短文】Urban Planning Blog: High density in metropolitan areas leads to longer commute times. However, an official confirmed that the city had completed the subway extension just in time to relieve the holiday traffic. Q: What helped relieve the holiday traffic?
options: A. The completion of the subway extension.
B. The high density of the area.
C. The increase in commute times.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。文中提到「城市已及時完成了地鐵延伸工程 (had completed the subway extension) 以緩解假期交通」，故選 A。

normal.desc: 【短文】Tech News: A popular social network was criticized for allowing deceptive ads. The CEO apologized, stating that their moderation team had not anticipated such a sophisticated manipulation tactic. Q: What did the CEO admit?
options: A. The ads were completely truthful.
B. The team failed to foresee the advanced manipulation.
C. The users should have been more careful.
D. The moderation team created the ads.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B。CEO 的道歉聲明中提到「審核團隊並未預料到 (had not anticipated) 如此複雜的操縱手段」，選項 B 的 failed to foresee 對應了 had not anticipated。

normal.desc: 【短文】Scholarship Announcement: The foundation stated that they would subsidize tuition for fifty students next semester. The director mentioned that they had received over a thousand applications before the deadline closed. Q: How many students will receive financial help?
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。雖然基金會收到了超過一千份申請，但第一句明確指出他們「將補助五十名學生的學費 (would subsidize tuition for fifty students)」。

normal.desc: 【短文】Psychology Magazine: Empathy allows us to connect with others. A recent experiment demonstrated that subjects who had practiced active listening showed higher resilience against interpersonal conflicts. Q: What is a benefit of practicing active listening according to the text?
options: A. It creates more interpersonal conflicts.
C. It guarantees a successful career.
D. It increases resilience against conflicts.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D。文中指出，練習積極傾聽的受試者在面對人際衝突時，展現出「更高的韌性 (higher resilience against interpersonal conflicts)」，故 D 為正確答案。

normal.desc: 【短文】Retail Report: The clothing brand had already closed twenty physical stores before they launched their online application. The financial director explained that the shift to digital sales was necessary to maintain profitability. Q: What happened before the online app was launched?
options: A. Twenty physical stores were shut down.
B. The brand lost all its profitability.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。文中第一句提到，該品牌在推出線上應用程式之前，「已經關閉了二十家實體店面 (had already closed twenty physical stores)」，選項 A 的 shut down 與 closed 同義。

normal.desc: 【短文】City News: If the mayor had listened to the urban planners, the new residential zone wouldn't have been built so close to the industrial park. Now, residents are complaining about the air quality. Q: What can be inferred about the new residential zone?
options: A. It was built far away from the industrial park.
B. It is currently experiencing air quality issues.
C. It was designed perfectly by the urban planners.
D. It has no residents yet.
normal.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B。假設語氣指出市長當時沒有聽專家的話，所以住宅區建得離工業園區太近；現在居民正在抱怨空氣品質，可推論該區域目前面臨空氣品質問題。

normal.explain: 英文原句：Relieve the symptom。relieve 是「緩解；減輕」，symptom 是「症狀」。

normal.explain: 英文原句：Eligible for the scheme。eligible 意為「有資格的；符合條件的」，scheme 為「計畫；方案」。

normal.explain: 英文原句：Yield good results。yield 作動詞指「產生（結果或收益）」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

normal.speak: She said the flight had been diverted due to heavy snow.

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: They announced that only eligible members had received the voucher.

D. 他們宣布不符合資格的人也能拿到代金券。
normal.explain: 英文原句：They announced that only eligible members had received the voucher. eligible 意為「符合資格的」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

C. 教授要求我明天提交學位論文。
D. 教授覺得我的學位論文寫得不好。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The professor stated he had already reviewed my dissertation. dissertation 為「學位論文」，句子使用過去完成式表示在聲明前已完成審閱。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She asked if the new strategy would yield a surplus.
options: A. 她說新策略一定會產生盈餘。

D. 她宣布新策略已經產生了盈餘。
normal.explain: 英文原句：She asked if the new strategy would yield a surplus. asked if 意為「詢問是否」，yield a surplus 為「產生盈餘」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: If it were a viable solution, I would gladly endorse it.
options: A. 既然這是個可行的解決方案，我願意代言。
B. 它不是個可行的解決方案，所以我不會贊同。
C. 因為它不是個好辦法，所以我勉強同意了。
D. 如果那是個可行的解決方案，我很樂意贊同它。
normal.explain: 英文原句：If it were a viable solution, I would gladly endorse it. 此為與現在事實相反的假設語氣，表達因為不可行所以目前無法贊同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He admitted that he had been highly skeptical of the plan.
options: A. 他承認他曾經對該計畫高度懷疑。
B. 他否認他曾經對該計畫感到懷疑。
C. 他說他一直對該計畫充滿信心。
D. 他覺得其他人對該計畫太過懷疑。
normal.explain: 英文原句：He admitted that he had been highly skeptical of the plan. skeptical 意指「懷疑的」，間接引語搭配過去完成式表示過去的狀態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思

C. 醫生說診斷結果昨天才剛出爐。
D. 醫生說他還無法確定昨天的診斷。
normal.explain: 英文原句：The doctor said he had confirmed the diagnosis yesterday. diagnosis 為「診斷」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

normal.explain: 英文原句：If the deficit were smaller, would they hire more staff? (如果虧損小一點，他們會僱用更多員工嗎？) 選項 D 回應「是的，他們很可能會擴大團隊」正確對應假設語氣。

normal.explain: 英文原句：He told me that he had never written a dissertation before. (他告訴我他以前從未寫過學位論文。) 選項 A「考慮到他缺乏學術經驗，這很合理」最契合話題。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

normal.explain: 英文原句：If the voucher hadn't expired, I would have used it for the hotel. (如果代金券沒過期，我就會把它用在飯店了。) 選項 B「可惜你沒早點確認日期」是在回應這件過去已發生的憾事。

B. 他們告訴我那筆龐大的財務負債造成了紀錄的差異。

D. 他們告訴我如果沒有差異，就不會有財務上的責任。
normal.explain: 英文原句：They told me that the discrepancy in the records had caused a huge financial liability. 意思：他們告訴我紀錄中的差異已經造成了龐大的財務負債。discrepancy 意指「差異、不一致」。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the passenger had declared the item, the customs would not have fined him so heavily.
options: A. He will declare the item next time.
B. The customs did not fine him at all.
C. The passenger always declares his items.
D. It's a tough lesson to learn about airport rules.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If the passenger had declared the item, the customs would not have fined him so heavily. 意思：如果那名乘客當時有申報該物品，海關就不會對他罰款這麼重。選項 D「這是關於機場規定的一次慘痛教訓」最適合。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She confirmed that the support team had already resolved the customer's formal grievance.
options: A. 她確認支援團隊已經解決了客戶的正式申訴。
B. 她確認支援團隊將會處理客戶的抱怨。
C. 她說支援團隊還沒有收到客戶的正式申訴。
D. 她確認客戶已經取消了對支援團隊的投訴。
normal.explain: 英文原句：She confirmed that the support team had already resolved the customer's formal grievance. 意思：她確認支援團隊已經解決了客戶的正式申訴。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If the contingency fund had been larger, we would have survived the sudden financial crisis.
options: A. We survived the crisis easily.
B. Unfortunately, our savings just weren't enough.
C. The crisis hasn't happened yet.
D. We should reduce the fund next year.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If the contingency fund had been larger, we would have survived the sudden financial crisis. 意思：如果應急準備金當時能多一點，我們就能挺過那場突如其來的金融危機了。選項 B「遺憾的是，我們的存款就是不夠」最合適。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: He asked if the engineering team had thoroughly tested the prototype before the official launch.
options: A. 他問工程團隊是否會在發布後測試原型。
B. 他問工程團隊是否打算取消原型的發布。
C. 他問工程團隊在正式發布前是否已經徹底測試過原型。
D. 他確認工程團隊在發布前沒有測試過原型。
normal.explain: 英文原句：He asked if the engineering team had thoroughly tested the prototype before the official launch. 意思：他問工程團隊在正式發布前是否已經徹底測試過原型。使用過去完成式的間接問句。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
normal.speak: If we had mitigated the risk effectively, the company's liability would have been practically zero.
options: A. The company has zero liability now.
B. I will mitigate the risk tomorrow.
C. The risk was effectively eliminated.
D. True, but we failed to act in time and now we pay the price.
normal.explain: 英文原句：If we had mitigated the risk effectively, the company's liability would have been practically zero. 意思：如果我們當時有效地減輕了風險，公司的責任實際上就會是零。選項 D「沒錯，但我們當時沒及時行動，現在只能付出代價」最符合第三條件句的語境。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
normal.speak: She mentioned that if the system were compatible, they would not need such a long transition.
options: A. 她提到如果系統相容，他們就不需要這麼長的過渡期。
B. 她提到因為系統相容，所以不需要很長的過渡期。
C. 她提到如果系統曾經相容過，就不會需要過渡期。
D. 她提到就算系統相容，他們還是需要很長的過渡期。
normal.explain: 英文原句：She mentioned that if the system were compatible, they would not need such a long transition. 意思：她提到如果系統相容，他們就不需要這麼長的過渡期。

normal.desc: 【職場-假設語氣】If the supervisor ___ clearer boundaries, the remote team would not feel so stressed.
normal.explain: 【解析】本題測試 If 第二類條件句（與現在事實相反）。從句動詞需用過去式，主要子句用 would + 原形動詞。選項 (A) established 是過去式，符合句型。其他選項時態皆不符。

normal.desc: 【職場-間接引語】The director announced that they ___ a hybrid work model the previous month.
normal.explain: 【解析】本題測試間接引語與過去完成式。主要動詞 announced 是過去式，表示「前一個月（the previous month）」發生的事，需退後一個時態變成過去完成式 (had + V-p.p.)，故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【職場-過去完成式】By the time the online meeting started, John ___ his microphone issue.
normal.explain: 【解析】By the time 引導的過去時間子句中，表示在該動作（started）發生「之前」就已經完成的動作，須用過去完成式 (had resolved)，故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【職場-字彙】Working from home without regular social interaction can easily lead to a sense of ___.
normal.explain: 【解析】isolation 意指「孤立；隔離」。句意：缺乏定期社交互動的居家辦公很容易導致孤立感。fatigue (疲勞)、dispute (爭議)、sculpture (雕塑) 語意皆不符。

normal.desc: 【職場-對話】A: 「Did you reply to the urgent email?」 B: 「If I had seen it earlier, I ___ immediately.」
normal.explain: 【解析】本題測試 If 第三類條件句（與過去事實相反）。If 從句用過去完成式 (had seen)，主要子句需用 would have + V-p.p.，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【職場-時態】She realized that she ___ the wrong document to the client before she went to bed.
normal.explain: 【解析】在意識到（realized）之前就已經發生的動作，必須使用過去完成式表示「過去的過去」，故選 (B) had sent。

normal.desc: 【短文】IT Memo: We experienced a brief server outage this morning. The senior technician told his coworkers that he had forgotten to update the firewall software last night, which ultimately caused the delay in our system boot. Q: What caused the delay?
options: C. Forgetting to update the software.
normal.explain: 【解析】根據短文，資深技師告訴同事他「忘記更新防火牆軟體 (had forgotten to update the firewall software)」，這導致了系統啟動延遲。因此選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【職場-字彙】To maintain high ___ while working remotely, you should take short breaks every hour.
normal.explain: 【解析】productivity 意指「生產力」。句意：為了在遠距工作時維持高生產力，你應該每小時短暫休息。其他選項 penalty (罰款)、infection (感染)、exhibition (展覽) 皆不合理。

normal.desc: 【氣候-假設語氣】If our society ___ heavily on fossil fuels, the air quality would improve drastically.
normal.explain: 【解析】本題測試 If 第二類條件句（與現在事實相反）。主要子句使用 would improve，故 If 從句需使用過去式 (did not rely)，選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【氣候-過去完成式】The scientists found that the glacier ___ much faster than they had originally thought.
normal.explain: 【解析】科學家「發現 (found)」是過去式，而冰川融化的動作發生在發現以及最初的預想之前，故應使用過去完成式 (had melted)，選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【氣候-間接引語】The environmentalist warned that the rising sea levels ___ coastal cities in the future.
normal.explain: 【解析】本題為間接引語。引述動詞 warned 為過去式，原句中的未來式 will threaten 必須退後一個時態變成 would threaten，故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【氣候-字彙】Many governments are investing in ___ solutions to protect the environment and reduce waste.
normal.explain: 【解析】ecological 意指「生態的；環保的」。句意：許多政府正投資於環保解決方案以保護環境並減少浪費。其他選項 abstract (抽象的)、chronic (慢性的)、illegal (非法的) 皆不符語意。

normal.desc: 【氣候-對話】A: 「The forest fire was devastating.」 B: 「If they had banned campfires earlier, the disaster ___.」
normal.explain: 【解析】與過去事實相反的假設語氣（第三類條件句）。從句用 had banned，主要子句需搭配 would (not) have + V-p.p.，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【氣候-時態】Before the new conservation law passed, the local wildlife population ___ dramatically.
normal.explain: 【解析】在過去的某個時間點（法律通過，passed）之前已經完成的動作，需使用過去完成式 (had decreased)，故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【短文】Corporate Press Release: We are committed to a greener future. During yesterday's press conference, the spokesperson confirmed that the factory had reduced its carbon footprint by 15% over the last five years, exceeding initial expectations. Q: What did the factory achieve?
options: A. It opened a new branch.
C. It reduced its carbon footprint.
D. It increased its overall production.
normal.explain: 【解析】短文中提到發言人確認該工廠在過去五年內減少了 15% 的碳足跡 (had reduced its carbon footprint by 15%)，故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【氣候-字彙】It is important to protect the natural ___ of endangered species to prevent their extinction.
normal.explain: 【解析】habitat 意指「棲息地」。句意：保護瀕危物種的自然棲息地以防止牠們滅絕是很重要的。therapy (治療)、verdict (判決)、portrait (肖像) 皆不合理。

normal.desc: 【健康-假設語氣】If people ___ more vegetables and less processed food, their immune systems would be stronger.
normal.explain: 【解析】主要子句有 would be，判斷為與現在事實相反的第二類條件句，因此 If 從句中的動詞需使用過去式 (consumed)，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【健康-過去完成式】By the time he saw the doctor, his symptoms ___ for over three weeks.
normal.explain: 【解析】By the time + 過去式 (saw)，表示在看醫生之前症狀就已經持續了三週，需用過去完成式 (had persisted)，選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【健康-間接引語】The nurse reminded the patient that he ___ his medicine after meals.
normal.explain: 【解析】間接引語中，護士提醒病人的內容是一種建議或義務，過去式的引述動詞 (reminded) 後面常搭配 should + 原形動詞，表示「應該要吃藥」，故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【健康-字彙】Without a proper diet and enough sleep, it is easy to suffer from constant ___.
normal.explain: 【解析】fatigue 意指「疲勞」。句意：如果沒有適當的飲食和充足的睡眠，很容易遭受持續的疲勞。其他選項皆與健康語境無關。

normal.desc: 【健康-對話】A: 「He fainted during the marathon.」 B: 「If he had stayed hydrated, he ___ such a severe condition.」
normal.explain: 【解析】對話討論過去發生的事，使用第三類條件句。從句為 had stayed，主要子句需用 would (not) have + V-p.p.，表示「本來可以避免」，選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【健康-時態】The researchers discovered that the virus ___ to several other regions before the quarantine began.
normal.explain: 【解析】病毒擴散發生在開始隔離 (began) 之前，屬於「過去的過去」，因此要用過去完成式 (had spread)，選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【短文】Patient Record Notes: The patient came in complaining of vision blurriness. During the consultation, she mentioned that she had suffered from severe headaches for months before she finally changed her prescription glasses. Q: What issue did the patient have before changing her glasses?
normal.explain: 【解析】短文中提到病患表示在換處方眼鏡前，已經受嚴重頭痛之苦好幾個月 (had suffered from severe headaches for months)，故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【健康-字彙】Doctors often prescribe physical ___ to help patients recover their mobility after an accident.
normal.explain: 【解析】therapy 意指「治療；療法」。physical therapy 是「物理治療」。句意：醫生經常開立物理治療來幫助病患在意外後恢復活動能力。選 (D)。

normal.desc: 【藝術-假設語氣】If the museum ___ the rare painting, it would attract thousands of art lovers globally.
normal.explain: 【解析】主要子句有 would attract，為與現在事實相反的第二類條件句，If 從句需使用動詞過去式 (displayed)，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【藝術-過去完成式】The curator noted that the sculpture ___ minor damage before it was shipped to the gallery.
normal.explain: 【解析】雕像受損的動作發生在被運送 (was shipped) 到畫廊之前，代表過去的過去，需使用過去完成式 (had suffered)，選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【藝術-間接引語】The critic wrote that the contemporary exhibition ___ the boundaries of traditional aesthetics.
normal.explain: 【解析】引述動詞 wrote 為過去式，從句時態必須配合退後。四個選項中只有 (C) had pushed 符合過去的時態（過去完成式），表示展覽已經推翻了界限。

normal.desc: 【藝術-字彙】The artist drew her ___ from the beautiful landscapes she saw during her trip to Italy.
normal.explain: 【解析】inspiration 意指「靈感」。句意：這位藝術家從她義大利之旅所見的美麗風景中汲取靈感。其他選項皆與藝術創作無關。

normal.desc: 【藝術-對話】A: 「The concert tickets sold out in minutes.」 B: 「If we had known earlier, we ___ online faster.」
normal.explain: 【解析】第三類條件句，與過去事實相反。If 從句用 had known，主要子句需搭配 would have + V-p.p. (would have queued)，表示「我們本來會更快上網排隊」，選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【藝術-時態】When the audience finally entered the theater, the orchestra ___ tuning their instruments.
normal.explain: 【解析】當觀眾進入 (entered) 劇院時，管弦樂團「已經」完成了調音。發生在過去動作之前的動作，使用過去完成式 (had finished)，選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【藝術-間接引語】The author explained that he ___ the novel over a span of ten years.
normal.explain: 【解析】間接引語中引述動詞 explained 是過去式，從句表示在他解釋之前已經寫了十年，需退後一個時態使用過去完成式 (had written)，選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【藝術-字彙】The gallery features a collection of ___ art, focusing on shapes and colors rather than realistic figures.
normal.explain: 【解析】abstract 意指「抽象的」。句意：該畫廊主打抽象藝術，著重於形狀與色彩而非寫實的人物。其他選項皆不合語意。

normal.desc: 【法律-假設語氣】If the government ___ stricter privacy laws, tech companies would not misuse user data.
normal.explain: 【解析】主要子句有 would not misuse，為與現在事實相反的第二類條件句。If 從句需用過去式動詞 (enforced)，故選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【法律-過去完成式】The lawyer proved that the corporation ___ the safety regulations before the accident occurred.
normal.explain: 【解析】違反規定的動作發生在意外發生 (occurred) 之前，表示過去的過去，需使用過去完成式 (had violated)，選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【法律-間接引語】The judge stated that the defendant ___ the terms of the contract intentionally.
normal.explain: 【解析】間接引語中，引述動詞 stated 為過去式，從句原本的過去式 (breached) 須退後為過去完成式 (had breached)，故選 (C)。

normal.desc: 【法律-字彙】Consumers have the right to file a ___ if they purchase products that are inherently dangerous.
normal.explain: 【解析】lawsuit 意指「訴訟」。file a lawsuit 意為「提起訴訟」。句意：消費者若買到具潛在危險的產品，有權提起訴訟。選 (D)。

normal.desc: 【法律-對話】A: 「The customer lost the case.」 B: 「If she had kept the original receipt, she ___ the dispute easily.」
normal.explain: 【解析】If 從句使用 had kept，表示與過去事實相反（她沒有保留收據）。主要子句需用 would have + V-p.p. (would have won)，選 (A)。

normal.desc: 【法律-時態】The authorities discovered that the store ___ illegal goods for months before being reported.
normal.explain: 【解析】販賣非法商品發生在被檢舉 (before being reported) 和當局發現 (discovered) 之前，屬於過去的過去，需使用過去完成式，故選 (B)。

normal.desc: 【AI與工作-字彙】The new program can ___ human conversations very well, making customer service faster.
normal.explain: 空格處需要填入符合句意的動詞。simulate 意為「模擬」，符合「模擬人類對話」的情境。stimulate 為刺激，calculate 為計算，operate 為操作，皆不符合句意。

normal.desc: 【AI與工作-間接引語】The engineer explained that the system ___ a major update the following week.
normal.explain: 本題測驗間接引語的時態一致性。主要子句的動詞 explained 是過去式，且句尾有 the following week（原為 next week），表示未來的動作在間接引語中需退一步退成過去未來式（would + 原形動詞），故選 D。

normal.desc: 【AI與工作-字彙】Because of ___, many repetitive tasks in the factory are now done by robots instead of humans.
normal.explain: 句意為「因為自動化，工廠裡許多重複性的工作現在都由機器人取代人類來完成」。automation 意為「自動化」，符合語境。negotiation 為談判，permission 為允許，translation 為翻譯。

normal.desc: 【AI與工作-對話】A: 「Why did the project fail?」 B: 「If we had tested the AI model properly, we ___ this issue.」
normal.explain: 本題測驗與過去事實相反的假設語氣（第三類條件句）。If 子句使用過去完成式 (had tested)，主要子句需搭配「would/could/might + have + p.p.」，表示「當時就能避免這個問題」，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【AI與工作-字彙】The director decided to ___ more funds to the research department for AI development.
normal.explain: 句意為「主管決定分配更多資金給研究部門以開發人工智慧」。allocate 意為「分配、撥出」，為正確答案。locate 為定位，violate 為違反，isolate 為隔離。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-假設】If the clinic had ordered more supplies, they ___ out of masks during the outbreak.
normal.explain: 本題測驗第三類條件句（與過去事實相反）。If 子句使用 had ordered，主要子句需使用 would have + p.p.，加上否定即為 wouldn't have run out of（就不會耗盡），故選 C。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-字彙】Wearing a mask is now ___ in all hospitals to protect patients and medical staff.
normal.explain: 句意為「現在所有醫院都強制要求戴口罩以保護病患和醫護人員」。mandatory 意為「強制的、義務的」，符合句意。temporary 為暫時的，imaginary 為想像的，satisfactory 為令人滿意的。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-間接引語】The doctor warned the patient that he ___ taking the medicine immediately.
normal.explain: 本題為間接引語。引述動詞 warned 是過去式，後方的名詞子句時態需要退一步。原本的 must 或是 have to 退一步成為過去式 had to，故選 A。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-時態】By the time the ambulance reached the scene, the volunteers ___ first aid to the victims.
normal.explain: 由 By the time 加上過去式動詞 reached 可知，志工給予急救的動作發生在救護車抵達之前，屬於「過去的過去」，因此必須使用過去完成式 (had given)。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-字彙】A large ___ of the city's budget will be spent on improving public health facilities this year.
normal.explain: 句意為「今年本市很大比例的預算將花在改善公共衛生設施上」。proportion 意為「比例、部分」，符合語境。prevention 為預防，profession 為職業，protection 為保護。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-對話】A: 「The hospital is understaffed.」 B: 「If they offered better salaries, more nurses ___ willing to join.」
normal.explain: 對話中的假設語氣 If they offered... 使用過去式，表示與現在事實相反的假設（第二類條件句），主要子句應使用 would + 原形動詞，故選 D。

normal.desc: 【公衛政策-字彙】The new policy aims to protect the most ___ groups, such as the elderly and those with chronic illnesses.
normal.explain: 句意為「這項新政策旨在保護最脆弱的族群，例如長者和慢性病患」。vulnerable 意為「脆弱的、易受傷的」，符合句意。valuable 為有價值的，variable 為多變的，visible 為看得見的。

normal.desc: 【短文】Health Alert: To prevent the spread of the virus, the government announced that all international travelers must undergo a rapid test upon arrival. Those who test positive will be sent to a designated hotel for a seven-day quarantine. Q: What happens if a traveler tests positive?
options: A. They must return to their home country immediately.
B. They are required to stay at a specific hotel for a week.
C. They have to pay a fine to the government.
D. They will be taken to a local hospital for surgery.
normal.explain: 題目問若旅客檢測呈陽性會發生什麼事。文中提到「Those who test positive will be sent to a designated hotel for a seven-day quarantine.」，即送往指定飯店隔離七天，與選項 B「要求在特定飯店待一週」相符。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-字彙】The small fishing village has managed to ___ itself into a popular resort destination.
normal.explain: 句意為「這座小漁村成功地將自己轉變為受歡迎的度假勝地」。transform 意為「使改變、轉換」，常搭配 into，為正確答案。transmit 為傳送，transport 為運輸，translate 為翻譯。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-時態】The tour guide realized that he ___ the tickets at the hotel counter before boarding the bus.
normal.explain: 句子表達導遊在「意識到（過去式 realized）」時，把票留在飯店櫃檯這個動作已經發生過了。描述過去某時間點之前已發生的動作，需使用過去完成式 (had left)。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-假設】If the town ___ more cultural festivals, it would attract a lot more international tourists.
normal.explain: 主要子句使用了 would attract，表示這是一個與現在事實相反的假設語氣（第二類條件句）。If 子句中的動詞必須使用過去式，因此選 C (hosted)。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-間接引語】The hotel receptionist told us that our room ___ ready in about thirty minutes.
normal.explain: 間接引語的時態變化題。因為引述動詞 told 為過去式，名詞子句原本的未來式 will be 必須退一步變成過去未來式 would be，故選 D。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-字彙】To ___ the historical buildings, the city council decided to limit the number of daily visitors.
normal.explain: 句意為「為了保存歷史建築，市議會決定限制每日遊客數量」。preserve 意為「保存、維護」，符合句意。reserve 為預訂，observe 為觀察，deserve 為應得。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-對話】A: 「The flight was delayed for six hours!」 B: 「If we had checked the weather forecast, we ___ a different travel date.」
normal.explain: 本題為第三類條件句（與過去事實相反）。If 子句使用過去完成式 (had checked)，主要子句需使用 would/could/might + have + p.p.，表示「當時本來可以選擇其他日期」，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【旅遊轉型-字彙】Many travelers nowadays prefer ___ local experiences rather than visiting typical tourist traps.
normal.explain: 句意為「現在許多旅客偏好道地的在地體驗，而不是去典型的觀光陷阱」。authentic 意為「真實的、道地的」，符合語境。athletic 為運動的，automatic 為自動的，artistic 為藝術的。

normal.desc: 【短文】Travel Blog: Ecotourism is on the rise. Instead of massive cruise ships, visitors are opting for small-group tours that support local businesses and protect the environment. This shift helps communities thrive without destroying their natural resources. Q: What is the main purpose of ecotourism according to the text?
options: A. To promote the building of larger cruise ships.
B. To lower the travel costs for international tourists.
C. To exploit natural resources for maximum profit.
D. To benefit local communities while protecting nature.
normal.explain: 題目詢問生態旅遊的主要目的。短文中提到生態旅遊支持當地企業、保護環境 (protect the environment)，並幫助社區繁榮 (helps communities thrive)，因此選項 D 最符合文章主旨。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-間接引語】The inspector announced that the new labeling regulations ___ into effect next month.
normal.explain: 引述動詞 announced 為過去式，從屬子句中描述未來的動作 (next month) 應將 will go 退一步為 would go，符合間接引語的時態規則。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-字彙】Consumers should carefully read the list of ___ to avoid allergic reactions.
normal.explain: 句意為「消費者應仔細閱讀成分表以避免過敏反應」。ingredients 意為「成分、原料」，是正確答案。instruments 為樂器/儀器，instructions 為指示，investments 為投資。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-假設】If the company had printed clear expiry dates, they ___ the massive product recall.
normal.explain: 這是與過去事實相反的假設語氣。條件子句使用 had printed (過去完成式)，主要子句必須使用 would/could/might + have + p.p.，因此選 A (本來就可以避免產品召回)。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-時態】The authorities found that the factory ___ expired meat for several months before the inspection.
normal.explain: 政府發現 (found) 是一個過去式的動作，而工廠使用過期肉類是發生在檢查「之前」好幾個月的事，屬於過去的過去，必須使用過去完成式 (had used)。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-字彙】The use of artificial food coloring is ___ prohibited in organic products.
normal.explain: 句意為「有機產品中嚴格禁止使用人工食用色素」。strictly 意為「嚴格地」，修飾 prohibited 非常自然。shortly 為不久，smoothly 為順利地，slightly 為輕微地。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-對話】A: 「The font on this nutrition label is too small.」 B: 「If the text were larger, it ___ much easier for elderly people to read.」
normal.explain: 這句對話使用了第二類條件句 (If the text were larger)，表示與現在事實相反，因此主要子句需要用 would + 原形動詞 (would be)。

normal.desc: 【食安標示-字彙】The government plans to establish a new agency to ___ the production and distribution of dietary supplements.
normal.explain: 句意為「政府計劃成立一個新機構來規範膳食補充劑的生產與銷售」。regulate 意為「規範、管理」，符合句意。calculate 為計算，formulate 為制定，stimulate 為刺激。

normal.desc: 【短文】Consumer Advice: When buying imported snacks, always look for the official safety certification mark. Products without this sticker have not been tested for harmful chemicals and could pose a risk to your health. Q: What should buyers do according to the advice?
options: A. Avoid buying any imported snacks.
B. Check for a specific safety sticker on the packaging.
C. Test the snacks for chemicals themselves.
D. Only purchase snacks that are brightly colored.
normal.explain: 短文中建議消費者在購買進口零食時，應尋找官方的安全認證標誌 (look for the official safety certification mark)，並提到沒有這張貼紙的產品可能會有風險，因此選 B。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-字彙】The city is promoting electric buses to reduce greenhouse gas ___ in downtown areas.
normal.explain: 句意為「該市正在推廣電動公車，以減少市中心的溫室氣體排放」。emissions 意為「排放、排放物」，常與溫室氣體連用。commissions 為佣金，admissions 為入場費，submissions 為提交物。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-時態】By the time the new subway line opened, the construction budget ___ by twenty percent.
normal.explain: By the time 加上過去式 opened 點出過去的時間基準。預算增加的動作發生在地鐵開通「之前」，屬於過去的過去，需使用過去完成式 (had increased)。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-間接引語】The mayor promised that the city council ___ more bike lanes by the end of the year.
normal.explain: 主要子句動詞 promised 為過去式，名詞子句中描述「年底前將會建造」的未來動作，需要依據時態一致性退一步，將 will 轉成 would，故選 C。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-假設】If public transportation were completely free, fewer people ___ their cars to work.
normal.explain: 條件子句 If public transportation were... 顯示為第二類條件句，表示與現在事實相反的假設，主要子句要搭配 would + 原形動詞，所以選 would drive。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-字彙】To ___ the transition to green energy, the government is offering subsidies for purchasing electric vehicles.
normal.explain: 句意為「為了加速向綠能轉型，政府針對購買電動車提供補助」。accelerate 意為「加速、促進」，符合句意。calculate 為計算，decorate 為裝飾，celebrate 為慶祝。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-對話】A: 「The traffic jam was terrible this morning.」 B: 「If you had taken the train, you ___ late for the meeting.」
normal.explain: 對話討論的是今天早上已經發生的塞車，為與過去事實相反的假設語氣（第三類條件句）。If 子句用 had taken，主要子句應搭配 would have + p.p.，故選 B。

normal.desc: 【城市交通-字彙】The new bridge was designed specifically for ___ and cyclists, so cars are not allowed to enter.
normal.explain: 句意為「這座新橋是專為行人和自行車騎士設計的，所以禁止汽車進入」。pedestrians 意為「行人」，為正確答案。politicians 為政治家，physicians 為內科醫生，technicians 為技術人員。

boss.explain: An unprecedented controversy 意思是「史無前例的爭議」。

options: C. 已經有了實質的改善

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
options: D. 本來會是名正言順的
boss.explain: Would have been justified 意思是「本來會是名正言順的/有正當理由的」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.explain: An optimistic prospect 意思是「一個樂觀的前景」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Had they not intervened, the casualty rate would have doubled.
options: A. 因為他們介入了，所以傷亡率翻倍了。
B. 要是他們沒有介入，傷亡率就會翻倍。
C. 他們正準備介入，以免傷亡率翻倍。
D. 即使他們介入，傷亡率還是會翻倍。
boss.explain: 原句：Had they not intervened, the casualty rate would have doubled.（等於 If they had not intervened...），意思是「要是他們沒有介入，傷亡率就會翻倍」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The researcher claimed that empirical evidence had refuted the hypothesis.
options: A. 研究人員認為這個假設不需要證據。
B. 實證證據證明了這個假設是正確的。
C. 研究人員聲稱實證證據已經反駁了該假設。
D. 這個假設將在未來產生實證證據。
boss.explain: 原句：The researcher claimed that empirical evidence had refuted the hypothesis. 意思是「研究人員聲稱實證證據已經反駁了該假設」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the new policy were implemented, it would restrict our freedom.
options: A. 新政策已經實施，我們失去了自由。
B. 為了獲得自由，我們必須實施新政策。
C. 我們不應該討論會限制自由的新政策。
D. 如果實施新政策，它將限制我們的自由。
boss.explain: 原句：If the new policy were implemented, it would restrict our freedom. 意思是「如果實施新政策，它將限制我們的自由」（與現在/未來事實相反的假設）。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Had you realized the severity of the allegation, would you have acted differently?
options: A. Yes, I would have hired a lawyer immediately.
B. No, I will do the same thing tomorrow.
C. Yes, I realize it is very serious now.
D. No, I am not acting differently today.
boss.explain: 原句：Had you realized the severity of the allegation, would you have acted differently?（要是你當時了解到指控的嚴重性，你的作法會不同嗎？）回應 A「是的，我本來會立刻請律師」符合倒裝句型的假設語氣。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: What was her perspective on the new structural framework?
options: A. She will tell us tomorrow morning.
B. She mentioned that it had provided great insights.
C. She is thinking about the new framework.
D. She wants to build a new house.
boss.explain: 原句：What was her perspective on the new structural framework?（她對新的結構框架有什麼看法？）回應 B「她提到這提供了很棒的見解」使用了間接引語與過去完成式。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: If the tour guide hadn't lost the map, would we be lost now?
options: A. Yes, we had been lost yesterday.
B. No, we will buy a new map.
C. No, we would be enjoying the picturesque village by now.
D. Yes, the tour guide is very friendly.
boss.explain: 原句：If the tour guide hadn't lost the map, would we be lost now?（如果導遊當初沒弄丟地圖，我們現在會迷路嗎？）此為混合條件句，回應 C「不，我們現在應該正在欣賞如畫的村莊」最合理。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Did the manager explain why he was so reluctant to approve the budget?
options: A. He will approve it as soon as possible.
B. He doesn't like to spend too much money.
C. He is looking at the financial report right now.
D. He said that he had noticed some serious financial risks.
boss.explain: 原句：Did the manager explain why he was so reluctant to approve the budget?（經理有解釋他為什麼這麼不情願批准預算嗎？）回應 D「他說他注意到了一些嚴重的財務風險」完美結合間接引語及過去完成式。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The consultant emphasized that the new policies ___ mandatory for all staff members moving forward.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：主詞動詞 emphasized 為過去式，名詞子句配合時態一致原則應退回過去式 were。

boss.desc: 【時態】Hardly ___ the office when it started pouring rain outside.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：否定副詞 Hardly 置於句首時需倒裝，且搭配過去完成式表示「一...就...」，故選 had I left。

boss.desc: 【假設語氣】But for their expert guidance, our team ___ the ambitious project on time.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：But for (要不是) 帶出與過去事實相反的假設，主要子句應使用 would/could not have + 過去分詞。

boss.desc: 【時態與語氣】She admitted she ___ the warning signs prior to the system crash, but had chosen to ignore them.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：在系統崩潰（the system crash）之前就已經注意到警告標誌，必須使用過去完成式 had noticed。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The CEO expects managers to ___ conflict resolution effectively rather than ignoring underlying tensions.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：facilitate 意為「促進；使便利」，此處指經理應積極促成衝突的解決。

boss.desc: 【短文】A leading tech firm announced a drastic shift in its operations. The spokesperson stated that they had completely redesigned their algorithm to prioritize ethical content. If they hadn't faced public backlash last year, they probably wouldn't have initiated this change. Q: What motivated the firm to redesign its algorithm?
options: A. A desire to maximize profits immediately.
B. Negative reactions from the public in the past.
C. A sudden decrease in user engagement.
D. Government regulations imposed this year.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：短文中的假設語氣「如果去年沒有面臨大眾強烈反彈（public backlash），他們就不會開始這項變革」，指出原因在於過去大眾的負面反應。

boss.desc: 【短文】In his memoir, the diplomat recalled a tense negotiation. He wrote that if the opposing leader had not shown a willingness to compromise, the peace talks would have collapsed. He also noted that he had prepared extensively for the meeting. Q: What prevented the peace talks from failing?
options: A. The extensive preparation of the diplomat.
B. The opposing leader's readiness to make concessions.
C. The intervention of third-party nations.
D. The strict demands of the diplomat.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中提及若非對方領袖展現 willingness to compromise（妥協意願），和談就會破裂，即對方願意讓步阻止了失敗。concessions 與 compromise 意義相近。

boss.desc: 【短文】Market trends often fluctuate wildly. Last week, an analyst predicted that renewable energy stocks would surge. He explained that investors had grown wary of fossil fuels long before the recent climate summit. Q: What did the analyst say about investors' attitude towards fossil fuels?
options: A. They became concerned only after the climate summit.
B. They had lost interest in fossil fuels before the summit.
C. They consider fossil fuels a safe and growing investment.
D. They want to invest heavily in both sectors evenly.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中指投資者在氣候高峰會前很久（long before）就已對化石燃料感到謹慎/擔憂（grown wary of），故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】Subject: Mentorship Program. Hi all, if we were to launch the mentorship program next month, we would need at least twenty senior staff to volunteer. The HR director mentioned yesterday that she had only received five applications so far. Q: What is the current status of the mentorship program?
options: A. It has already successfully launched.
B. It has attracted too many volunteers.
C. It lacks the required number of senior volunteers.
D. It was canceled by the HR director yesterday.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：需要20名志工，但HR總監說目前只收到5份申請（had only received five applications），表示志工數量不足。

boss.desc: 【短文】The documentary highlights how urban areas can integrate green spaces. The narrator claimed that if city planners considered biodiversity during the design phase, cities would become more sustainable. He argued that they had historically prioritized concrete over nature. Q: What criticism does the narrator have regarding past city planners?
options: A. They focused too much on building with concrete.
B. They spent too much money on green spaces.
C. They integrated too many diverse species.
D. They completely ignored the design phase.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：文中指出過去的規劃者「historically prioritized concrete over nature」（歷史上優先考慮水泥而非自然），故選 A。

boss.desc: 【短文】During the performance review, Sarah was told that her communication skills were excellent. However, her manager pointed out that if she delegated tasks more often, she wouldn't suffer from burnout. Sarah admitted she had always struggled to trust others with critical work. Q: What is Sarah's main issue according to the text?
options: A. She lacks the ability to communicate clearly.
B. She hesitates to assign important tasks to others.
C. She delegates too much work to her team.
D. She ignores her manager's direct orders.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：經理建議她多委派任務（delegate），且她承認很難將重要工作交給他人（struggled to trust others with critical work），故選 B。

boss.desc: 【短文】When asked about the sudden delay, the spokesperson insisted that the logistics team had prepared everything properly. The delay, he explained, was due to unpredictable weather patterns. If the weather had remained stable, the shipment would have arrived on Tuesday. Q: Why was the shipment delayed?
options: A. The logistics team made a significant error.
B. The weather was unexpectedly bad.
C. The shipment departed later than scheduled.
D. The team failed to prepare properly.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：發言人說延遲是因為 unpredictable weather patterns（不可預測的天氣型態），且若天氣穩定原本週二就會抵達，故選 B。

【時態與語態】The new cognitive tests ___ to the students before the researchers realized there was a flaw in the design.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。本題考查過去完成式的被動語態 (had been + p.p.)。認知測驗是被施測的，且動作發生在研究人員「意識到 (realized)」之前，故須同時具備過去完成式與被動語態的結構。

boss.desc: 【假設語氣】If the local government had invested in infrastructure earlier, the recent flood damage ___ much less severe.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D。此為第三類條件句，描述與過去事實相反的假設。If 子句用 had invested (過去完成式)，主要子句對應的動詞型態必須是 would have + p.p. (would have been)。

boss.desc: 【間接引語】The politician firmly denied that he ___ the public data to win the re-election.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。句中的 denied (否認) 為過去式，所否認的「操縱數據」這件事發生在更早的過去，因此後方的子句必須使用過去完成式 (had manipulated)。

boss.desc: 【字彙】The ___ marketing strategy caused the company's stock to fluctuate rapidly, making investors very anxious.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B (欺騙的)。句意為「這種欺騙性的行銷策略導致公司股票劇烈波動，讓投資人十分焦慮」。A為負擔得起的，C為認知的，D為有韌性的，皆不符合句意邏輯。

boss.desc: 【對話-時態】A: 「Did you manage to secure a credible source for the article?」 B: 「Yes, but only after I ___ three other anonymous informants.」
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。B回覆說「是的，但這是在我訪問了其他三名匿名線人之後」，因為「成功取得可靠消息來源 (manage to secure)」已是過去式，所以在這之前發生的訪問動作必須使用過去完成式 (had interviewed)。

boss.desc: 【對話-假設】A: 「The curriculum reform is facing a lot of backlash.」 B: 「If they had consulted the teachers first, they ___ this much resistance.」
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D。If 子句為 had consulted (過去完成式)，這是一個與過去事實相反的假設，因此主要子句必須使用 would/could/might + have + p.p. 的形式，即 wouldn't have faced。

boss.desc: 【對話-間接引語】A: 「Will the residential density increase next year?」 B: 「The journalist asked the planner if the residential density ___ the following year.」
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。當引述句為過去式 asked 時，原本句子中的未來式 will 必須往後退一步，變成過去未來式 would。B為現在未來式，C為現在式，D為過去完成式，皆錯誤。

boss.desc: 【字彙】To help citizens better ___ the complex tax policies, the government launched a simplified interactive website.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B (理解)。句意為「為了幫助市民更好地理解複雜的稅收政策，政府推出了一個簡化的互動網站」。A為補助，C為波動，D為通勤，皆不符合語境。

boss.desc: 【短文-推論】Economics Blog: By the time the central bank raised interest rates, the inflation rate had already reached a ten-year high. Critics argued that if the bank had acted two months earlier, consumer expenditure wouldn't have shrunk so drastically. Q: What is the main criticism against the central bank?
options: A. They ignored the inflation data completely.
B. They should have subsidized consumer expenditure.
C. They acted too late to prevent a severe drop in spending.
D. They raised interest rates too high.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 C。文中批評者指出「如果央行早兩個月行動，消費者支出就不會嚴重縮水」，言下之意就是央行行動得太晚 (acted too late)，導致了支出的劇烈下降。

boss.desc: 【短文-細節】Urban Daily: The transit authority announced that they had finally secured the budget for the new railway. The director noted that if the funds hadn't been delayed by political debates, commuters would be enjoying the new amenity right now. Q: Why aren't commuters using the new railway yet?
options: A. The budget was rejected by the director.
B. Commuters prefer driving their own cars.
C. The construction has been completed early.
D. The funds were delayed by political debates.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 D。文中的假設語氣「如果資金沒有被政治辯論延誤，通勤者現在就能享受到這項新設施」，反面證明了現實情況是「資金被政治辯論延誤了 (funds were delayed by political debates)」。

boss.desc: 【短文-推論】Media Today: In an era of deceptive content, promoting digital literacy is critical. A recent study found that teenagers who had received specialized instruction were better at identifying sensationalized news. The researchers stated that schools must facilitate such programs immediately. Q: What does the study suggest about teenagers?
options: A. They can improve their ability to spot fake news through instruction.
B. They share sensationalized news more than adults do.
C. They are naturally immune to deceptive content.
D. They manipulate digital media for personal gain.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 A。文中提到「接受過專門指導的青少年更善於辨識聳動的新聞 (better at identifying sensationalized news)」，代表他們的能力是可以透過教導 (instruction) 來提升的。

boss.desc: 【短文-推論】The psychologist emphasized that resilience is not a fixed trait. In his presentation, he explained that if individuals were exposed to manageable stress, they would develop better coping mechanisms. He added that many patients had shown significant improvement after cognitive therapy. Q: According to the psychologist, how can one develop better coping mechanisms?
options: A. By possessing a fixed trait of resilience.
B. By facing manageable amounts of stress.
C. By avoiding all stressful situations.
D. By reading cognitive psychology books.
boss.explain: 繁體中文解說：正確答案是 B。演講中提到「如果人們暴露在可控的壓力下 (were exposed to manageable stress)，他們就能發展出更好的應對機制」，這直接對應選項 B。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.explain: 英文原句：Highly skeptical。highly 意為「高度地」，skeptical 是「懷疑的」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.explain: 英文原句：A thorough diagnosis。thorough 意為「徹底的；詳細的」，diagnosis 為「診斷」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.explain: 英文原句：Publish a dissertation。publish 為「發表；出版」，dissertation 為「學位論文」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.explain: 英文原句：An accurate projection。accurate 是「準確的」，projection 指「預測；推測」。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: Had they amended the rules, the issue would have been solved.
options: A. 因為他們修改了規則，所以問題解決了。
B. 他們雖然修改了規則，但問題還是沒解決。
C. 如果他們未來修改規則，問題就能解決。
D. 如果他們當時修改了規則，問題就已經解決了。
boss.explain: 英文原句：Had they amended the rules, the issue would have been solved. 這是省略 If 的第三類假設語氣倒裝句，代表當時並未修改規則，問題也沒解決。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the curriculum were updated, students would be more engaged.
options: A. 學生們已經對更新後的課程內容很投入。
B. 除非學生投入，否則課程內容不會更新。
C. 課程已經被更新，因為學生不夠投入。
D. 如果課程內容更新，學生們會更投入。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the curriculum were updated, students would be more engaged. 這是與現在事實相反的假設語氣，表達對未來的期望或條件假設。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the projection had been accurate, we wouldn't face this deficit.
options: A. 預測很準確，所以我們沒有面臨虧損。
B. 如果當時預測準確，我們現在就不會面臨這個虧損。
C. 即使預測準確，我們還是會面臨嚴重的虧損。
D. 我們面臨虧損，是因為我們沒有做任何預測。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the projection had been accurate, we wouldn't face this deficit. 錯綜時間條件句：如果「過去」預測準確，我們「現在」就不會面臨虧損。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: If the faculty had voted, the changes would have taken effect.
options: A. 全體教職員已經投票，所以變更生效了。
B. 全體教職員不想投票，但變更還是生效了。
C. 如果當時全體教職員投票，變更就會生效了。
D. 即使全體教職員投票，變更也不會生效。
boss.explain: 英文原句：If the faculty had voted, the changes would have taken effect. 第三類條件句，意指當時並未投票，因此變更沒有生效。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？
boss.speak: Had the projection been more realistic, we wouldn't have lost money.
options: A. We will make a lot of money soon.
B. I agree, we should have been less optimistic.
C. The projection is usually very accurate.
D. We didn't lose any money last year.
boss.explain: 英文原句：Had the projection been more realistic, we wouldn't have lost money. (如果預測更實際一點，我們就不會賠錢了。) 選項 B「我同意，我們本來應該少一點樂觀」是正確的回應。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The spokesperson stated that if they had incorporated the feedback, the disaster could have been avoided.
options: A. 他們因為納入了回饋，成功避免了災難。
B. 災難本來無法避免，即使他們納入回饋。
C. 其實他們忽略了回饋，這導致了災難發生。
D. 發言人表示未來會納入回饋來避免災難。
boss.explain: 英文原句：...if they had incorporated the feedback, the disaster could have been avoided. (如果當時納入回饋，這場災難本可避免。) 隱含事實是他們沒有納入回饋，所以發生了災難。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: My colleague mentioned that she would have joined the faculty if the salary had been more attractive.
options: A. 因為薪水很優渥，所以她加入了全體教職員。
B. 她正在猶豫是否要因為高薪加入全體教職員。
C. 如果薪水更低，她就絕對不會加入教職員團隊。
D. 她沒有加入教職員團隊，是因為薪水不夠理想。
boss.explain: 英文原句：...she would have joined the faculty if the salary had been more attractive. 第三類條件句表示過去未發生的事，代表薪水不夠吸引人，所以她沒加入。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出正確的意思
boss.speak: The reviewer claimed that he had been highly skeptical until he saw the actual performance.
options: A. 評論家看完實際表演後，變得更加懷疑了。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽到這句話，最適合的回應是？

boss.explain: 英文原句：If he hadn't taken the necessary precautions, his consecutive mistakes would have eventually cost him his career. 意思：如果他當時沒有採取必要的預防措施，他連續的失誤最終會毀了他的職業生涯。選項 B「還好他後來終於開始小心謹慎了」最為貼切。

boss.desc: 【短文】Email to all staff: 'We understand that working remotely can blur the lines between personal life and duty. Last week, our CEO mentioned that the management had noticed a rising trend in overtime hours. Therefore, a new policy on disconnecting after 6 PM will be introduced.' Q: What did the management notice according to the CEO?
options: A. A decrease in remote workers.
C. An increase in overtime hours.
D. A lack of social events.
boss.explain: 【解析】信件中明確寫道「management had noticed a rising trend in overtime hours (管理層注意到加班時數有上升的趨勢)」，故正確答案為 (C)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Remote Work Survey: A recent study on telecommuting revealed surprising facts. Many respondents stated that if they had received proper technical support from their IT departments initially, they would not have experienced so much frustration during the first few months. Q: What caused frustration for the respondents initially?
boss.explain: 【解析】文中提到「如果一開始有得到適當的技術支援 (had received proper technical support)，就不會經歷這麼多挫折」。這表示最初的挫折來源是缺乏技術支援，選 (D)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Energy Update: To combat climate change, the city council decided to replace all streetlights with solar-powered alternatives. The mayor proudly announced yesterday that the city had reduced its electricity expenses by 20% since the project began. Q: What has the city achieved according to the mayor?
options: A. A 20% reduction in electricity expenses.
B. A ban on all fossil fuels.
C. The invention of new solar panels.
D. A decrease in traffic accidents.
boss.explain: 【解析】市長宣布自從計畫開始後，該城市「had reduced its electricity expenses by 20% (已減少 20% 的電費支出)」，故答案為 (A)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Ecology Blog: Protecting the wetlands is our top priority. An ecologist pointed out that if developers had not drained the northern swamps last decade, the native bird population would not have plummeted so drastically. Action must be taken now. Q: What led to the decline of the native bird population?
options: B. The draining of the northern swamps.
C. The pollution of the local river.
boss.explain: 【解析】生態學家指出「如果開發商沒有排乾北部沼澤 (had not drained the northern swamps)，鳥類數量就不會暴跌」。由此推論鳥類減少的原因是排乾了沼澤，選 (B)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Medical News: A new vaccine for the seasonal flu has shown promising results. The lead scientist explained that volunteers who had received the injection exhibited a much stronger immune response compared to the control group. She emphasized the importance of widespread vaccination. Q: What did the volunteers who received the injection show?
options: D. A sudden drop in blood pressure.
boss.explain: 【解析】文中提到接受注射的志願者「exhibited a much stronger immune response (展現出強得多的免疫反應)」，與選項 (C) 描述完全相符。

boss.desc: 【短文】Health Magazine: Managing stress is crucial for heart health. A cardiologist noted that if her patients exercised regularly and maintained a balanced diet, their risk of cardiovascular diseases would drop significantly. She advised starting with a simple 30-minute daily walk. Q: How can patients lower their risk of cardiovascular diseases according to the cardiologist?
options: B. By sleeping ten hours a day.
C. By avoiding all outdoor activities.
D. By exercising and eating a balanced diet.
boss.explain: 【解析】心臟科醫生指出「如果病患規律運動並維持均衡飲食 (exercised regularly and maintained a balanced diet)」，罹患心血管疾病的風險就會大幅降低。故選 (D)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Art Review: The new contemporary gallery has sparked mixed reactions. One renowned critic wrote that the artist had captured the essence of modern loneliness perfectly through his abstract sculptures. However, some traditionalists found the pieces confusing. Q: How did the renowned critic feel about the abstract sculptures?
options: A. They captured modern loneliness perfectly.
B. They were confusing and poorly made.
C. They were too expensive to purchase.
boss.explain: 【解析】文中寫道著名評論家認為藝術家「had captured the essence of modern loneliness perfectly (完美捕捉了現代孤獨的本質)」，故選 (A)。覺得令人困惑的是傳統派人士，並非該評論家。

boss.desc: 【短文】Cultural Exhibition: The local museum is hosting a showcase of 19th-century portraits. The curator stated during the opening that if the museum had not secured funding from anonymous donors, they would never have been able to restore these delicate works. Q: What made the restoration of the portraits possible?
options: A. Ticket sales from the previous year.
C. Government grants for the arts.
D. Volunteer work from local artists.
boss.explain: 【解析】策展人表示「如果沒有獲得匿名捐贈者的資金 (had not secured funding from anonymous donors)，就永遠無法修復這些作品」，代表是這筆資金讓修復成為可能，選 (B)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Consumer Rights Notice: Be aware of deceptive online subscriptions. The consumer protection agency warned that many users had signed up for free trials, only to be charged hidden monthly fees later because they didn't read the fine print. Q: Why were many users charged hidden fees?
options: A. They lost their credit cards.
C. They did not read the fine print.
boss.explain: 【解析】機構警告許多用戶被收取隱藏費用的原因是「because they didn't read the fine print (因為他們沒有閱讀附帶的附屬細則/小字說明)」，故選 (C)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Legal Brief: A landmark verdict was reached today regarding workplace discrimination. The judge declared that if the company had implemented a fair evaluation system, the dispute would not have escalated into a massive class-action lawsuit. Q: What could have prevented the massive lawsuit?
options: C. Hiring a more expensive lawyer.
D. Implementing a fair evaluation system.
boss.explain: 【解析】法官聲明「如果公司落實了公平的評估系統 (had implemented a fair evaluation system)，爭議就不會升級為大規模訴訟」。因此公平的評估系統本可防止這場訴訟，選 (D)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Workplace Forum: Remote teams often struggle with cohesion. A team leader shared his experience, stating that his team had struggled with communication until they introduced daily virtual check-ins. Now, everyone feels much more connected. Q: What improved the team's communication?
boss.explain: 【解析】團隊領袖分享經驗，提到直到他們「引進了每日虛擬報到/會議 (introduced daily virtual check-ins)」後，溝通才獲得改善，大家覺得更有連結。故選 (A)。

boss.desc: 【短文】Environmental Policy: Last year's emission targets were not met. An analyst argued that if the administration enforced stricter penalties on heavy polluters, corporations would take sustainability much more seriously. Currently, the fines are too low to make an impact. Q: What does the analyst suggest to make corporations take sustainability seriously?
boss.explain: 【解析】分析師認為「如果政府對重度汙染者執行更嚴格的罰則 (enforced stricter penalties)，企業就會更認真對待永續發展」。因此建議的方法是 (B)。
